name: Garen, the Gate Guard
summary: A gate guard. Not a bad man — he just wants a few extra coins before the locks come down, to spend on drink. His memory is uncannily good: he remembers every face that has come through, especially the pretty, pale ones holding a violin case.

knows: The toll rules, and the room to 'mark it up'
The inquisitor's men are looking for 'a girl who doesn't age'

reactions.violin_note: At that cold note his face pales and his fingers tremble; he waves you through (but finds it odd later → quiet suspicion rise)
reactions.cover_mismatch: If a second visit's line doesn't match the last → he overcharges and looks twice (suspicion+)
